issues.path: detail (Exhibit I Employee Benefit Fund expenditure lines).category
issues.on_page: p6 Employee Benefit Fund column splits its 3,585,736.42 by function: regular instruction 2,238,956.39, special education 306,631.94, guidance 74,562.41, SPED school age 69,140.27, support-instruction 114,349.02, general administration 19,449.97, principal 191,140.14, O&M of plant 221,119.91, transportation 31,036.74 + 23,778.51, state & private 122,217.98, federal programs 173,353.14
issues.issue: All Employee Benefit spending is put under instruction, but p6 prints a function split. That moves about 744,577 of support services and student transportation into instruction, so the detail function totals don't tie to the statement's function lines. Flagged review already; recording it by function from p6 would be more accurate.

issues.on_page: Other Purchased Services (e.g. Operation of Buildings 187,370.12; Vehicle Operation 49,805.36, p24)
issues.issue: In the school chart of accounts, 'Other Purchased Services' is mostly insurance, communication, travel, tuition and printing, not professional services. Insurance might fit better for Operation of Buildings and Vehicle Operation. Judgment call.

issues.on_page: Other Expenses (e.g. Regular Instruction 55,440.86; Guidance 44,936.63, p20)
issues.issue: The 'Other Expenses' object is a catch-all (dues, fees, miscellaneous). Mapping all of it to dues, training and travel is a guess; it could be miscellaneous expenditure with review.

issues.path: detail (Exhibit P Operation of Buildings Supplies).detail_category
issues.issue: For plant operation, the school 'Supplies' object usually includes energy (electricity, natural gas). Part of this may belong in utilities (power, gas, phone). The page doesn't show the split, so the amount stays as printed.

issues.on_page: Exhibit G program budgets, e.g. 1100 Regular instruction budget 10,067,699.54
issues.issue: Replacing the Exhibit G program lines with Exhibit P drops the General Fund program budgets printed on pp9-10 (total budget 22,632,101.44). The actuals are not affected.
